question.text: If a Cat III AIF is structured as a Trust, the total income is taxed at:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 115UB(4), Cat III AIF trusts pay tax at MMR (30% base). The Trap: Slab/zero/15% are incorrect for Trust-structured Cat III AIF. Cross-Exam Context: Same MMR applies to indeterminate trusts under Section 164. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Build surcharge + 4% cess into after-tax return projections.
